about: Every API key or credential the code reads. Read by libs/ops/env_keys.py, scripts/check_keys.py and scripts/check_keys.ps1. Policy: public or licensed only; free self-registered keys count as licensed; paid data stays unused. X, Discord user tokens, Reddit, StockTwits and crypto venues are fenced (libs/data/terms_fence.py) and are not listed.
